section_vi_cross_pipeline_evaluation.critical_architectural_finding:
1. When OCR corrupts problem_text while facts remain clean (Path 2a), Source Gate (kiem_nguon) deterministically rejects the mismatch with QUOTE_NOT_IN_SOURCE / SOURCE_OBJECT_MISMATCH (fail-closed).
2. However, if an LLM extracts TypedFactNext directly from OCR-corrupted text (Path 2b), verbatim quotes inside the corrupted text PASS Source Gate! Specifically: (a) in OCR_C2_PRIME_DROPPED, dropping the prime in (A'BC) -> (ABC) causes d(A, (ABC)) = 0 to be served instead of d(A, (A'BC)) = 120/√1681; (b) in OCR_C4_NUMBER_CORRUPTED, corrupting SA = 3 -> SA = 8 causes d(A, SC) = 32/√10 = 16√10/5 to be served instead of 12√41/41! Meanwhile, structural corruptions like (P)->(B) (OCR_C3) or (ABC)->(AB) (OCR_C5) are caught by Source Gate / TypedFactNext schema validation. This proves why the Cross-Engine OCR Acceptance Gate (requiring zero math-token divergence and 0 unsafe accepts) is mandatory before feeding Local OCR text into TypedFactNext extraction.

part1_sole_height_anchor.solid: S.ABC (right at A, AB=6, AC=8, SA=SB=SC=13, h=12)
part1_sole_height_anchor.mathematical_proof: When k.apex is the sole height anchor (self.h2 is set by _dinh_tu_ba_canh_ben and no other independent _dat_ngoai_day call occurs), every point X in the figure has coordinates derived affine-linearly from the base plane z=0 and the single apex S=(f_x, f_y, z_S). Replacing z_S = +1 with z_S = -1 applies the global reflection R_z(x, y, z) = (x, y, -z). Because the Exact Kernel Gram bilinear form is g(u, v) = u_0*v_0 + u_1*b_11*v_1 + u_2*h2*v_2 (with zero cross-terms between (x,y) and z), R_z is an exact orthogonal isometry: g(R_z u, R_z v) = g(u, v) and |det(R_z u, R_z v, R_z w)| = |det(u, v, w)|. Therefore all lengths, distances, angles, areas, volumes, and section polygons are 100% invariant.

part2_two_independent_off_base_anchors.finding_and_recommendation: FIXED & VERIFIED: (1) _dinh_tu_ba_canh_ben now iterates over all pyramids in self.khoi sharing the root base (not just self.root) and records placed apices in self.mirror_apices. (2) In dung_tu_loi_goi, whenever dung.mirror_apices is non-empty: if the +z branch succeeds and the -z mirror branch also passes all premise certificates, all asked goal outputs are compared across both branches; any divergence raises TuChoi('AMBIGUOUS_FACT', ...), while identical outputs serve cleanly. Conversely, if the +z branch fails with INCONSISTENT_FACTS (e.g. a given distance SP = √314 holds only on -z) and the -z mirror branch passes all certificates, the -z branch is uniquely selected and served.
